name: Cartesian Chart
description: A framework-free Web Component that reads an ordinary HTML table and draws it as a line, area, column or bar chart. The table is the data, the no-script fallback and the accessible twin at once, and there is no second value axis to be had.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A line chart with a legend and a crosshair that reads every series at once.

variants.name: Bars
variants.description: Columns and horizontal bars, one series in one colour, always measured from zero.

variants.name: Stacked
variants.description: Part-to-whole over time, with the surface itself separating the segments.

variants.name: Scales
variants.description: Round ticks, a pinned range, thinned category labels, and why there is no second axis.

variants.name: Interaction
variants.description: The crosshair, the keyboard walking the same values, and a legend that never repaints the survivors.

variants.name: Table
variants.description: The data contract: written for a person, plotted as a number, and still there with no script.

variants.name: States
variants.description: One series, nothing at all, refetching, a failure, and the ninth colour that is never invented.
